facts: The paper targets generating generic action proposals in unconstrained videos.
Each action proposal corresponds to a temporal series of spatial bounding boxes.
A spatio-temporal video tube has a good potential to locate one human action.
Each action is assumed to be performed by a human with meaningful motion.
Appearance cues are utilized to measure the actionness of the video tubes.
Motion cues are utilized to measure the actionness of the video tubes.
Action proposal generation is formulated as a maximum set coverage problem.
Greedy search is performed to select a set of action proposals.
A set of action proposals can maximize the overall actionness score.
The action proposals do not rely on video segmentation.
The action proposals can be generated in nearly real-time.
Experimental results on two challenging datasets validate the superior performance of the action proposals.
MSRII and UCF 101 are two challenging datasets.
Experimental results validate competitive results on action detection and search.
A temporal series of spatial bounding boxes is a spatio-temporal video tube.
entities: temporal series of spatial bounding boxes
